from test.support import import_helper
pwd = import_helper.import_module('pwd')

def _t():
    entries = pwd.getpwall()
    for e in entries:
        assert len(e) == 7, ('assertEqual', len(e), 7)
        assert e[0] == e.pw_name, ('assertEqual', e[0], e.pw_name)
        assert isinstance(e.pw_name, str), ('assertIsInstance', e.pw_name, str)
        assert e[1] == e.pw_passwd, ('assertEqual', e[1], e.pw_passwd)
        assert isinstance(e.pw_passwd, str), ('assertIsInstance', e.pw_passwd, str)
        assert e[2] == e.pw_uid, ('assertEqual', e[2], e.pw_uid)
        assert isinstance(e.pw_uid, int), ('assertIsInstance', e.pw_uid, int)
        assert e[3] == e.pw_gid, ('assertEqual', e[3], e.pw_gid)
        assert isinstance(e.pw_gid, int), ('assertIsInstance', e.pw_gid, int)
        assert e[4] == e.pw_gecos, ('assertEqual', e[4], e.pw_gecos)
        assert type(e.pw_gecos) in (str, type(None)), ('assertIn', type(e.pw_gecos), (str, type(None)))
        assert e[5] == e.pw_dir, ('assertEqual', e[5], e.pw_dir)
        assert isinstance(e.pw_dir, str), ('assertIsInstance', e.pw_dir, str)
        assert e[6] == e.pw_shell, ('assertEqual', e[6], e.pw_shell)
        assert isinstance(e.pw_shell, str), ('assertIsInstance', e.pw_shell, str)
try:
    _t()
except BaseException as _e:
    print('ORACLE_EXC ' + type(_e).__name__ + ' ' + repr(str(_e)))
else:
    print('ok')
